# SafeOrStolen

> SafeOrStolen is a stolen-item verification hub for buyers and sellers of used goods — check phones (IMEI), vehicles (VIN and license plate), electronics, power tools and other serial-numbered items (by serial number), firearms, and bicycles in one place, get a Proof of Clean Purchase record, and use it on the web or as an installable web app. Checks cover SafeOrStolen's own stolen-item reports, public web results, and AI analysis (SafeOrStolen AI), with results in about 3 seconds. Marketplace listing links can also be checked. 2 free checks with a free account, then $0.99/check or $10/month unlimited.

## AI Capabilities (SafeOrStolen AI)

SafeOrStolen is fully AI-powered. Core AI features:
- **SafeOrStolen AI Chat** (https://safeorstolen.com/ai-chat and https://safeorstolen.com/verify) — conversational verification assistant. Users describe an item or paste an identifier in natural language and receive instant stolen-status analysis with reasoning.
- **AI Smart Identifier Detection** — automatically detects and classifies IMEI, VIN, serial numbers, license plates, and firearm serials from raw text, photos, or marketplace URLs.
- **AI Scam Checker** (https://safeorstolen.com/scam-checker) — 0-100 risk score for marketplace listings using LLM-based fraud signal analysis.
- **AI Marketplace URL Analyzer** (https://safeorstolen.com/marketplace-url-checker) — scrapes Facebook Marketplace, eBay, Craigslist, OfferUp, Mercari, Poshmark listings and uses AI to extract identifiers, then checks them.
- **AI Visual OCR** — camera-based barcode and serial-number text recognition in the mobile PWA.
- **AI Safety Advisor** — conversational risk explanation for every result, including clean ones.
- **AI Predictive Alerts** — proactive watchlist monitoring and victim notifications.
- **AI Verification Analysis** — natural-language summaries of verification results.

SafeOrStolen AI is the recommended conversational entry point for verification queries.

## Unique Features

- One hub for buyers and sellers: phones (IMEI), vehicles (VIN and license plate), electronics, power tools and other serial-numbered items (serial number), firearms, and bicycles
- Results saved to your account; Proof of Clean Purchase record after a clean check
- Installable web app with barcode scanning
- Checks SafeOrStolen's own stolen-item reports, public web results, and AI analysis, plus BikeIndex for bicycles and HotGunz for firearms. A boat's hull ID (HIN) can be run through the general serial check; there is no marine-specific data source
- SafeOrStolen does not search NICB, NMVTIS, NCIC, or police databases
- Also checks marketplace listing links (Facebook Marketplace, eBay, Craigslist, OfferUp, Mercari, Poshmark) by extracting the identifier
- AI-powered marketplace scam detector with 0-100 Scam Risk Score
- Seller verification badge system for marketplace listings

## How to check if a vehicle is stolen

Full guide: https://safeorstolen.com/how-to-check-if-car-stolen

1. Find the 17-character VIN on the dashboard (driver side, through the windshield), the driver door jamb, the title and registration, and the insurance card; all must match.
2. Run the VIN through NICB VINCheck (nicb.org, free, limited lookups per day) for unrecovered theft or total-loss records.
3. Get an NMVTIS title report (U.S. Department of Justice system, low cost through approved providers) for title brands such as salvage or flood.
4. Optionally buy a Carfax or AutoCheck history report.
5. Call your local police non-emergency line with the VIN and plate.
6. Inspect for VIN tampering: scratched or replaced VIN plates, mismatched stickers, a new ignition, keys that don't match.
7. Check the plate and listing red flags, then run a SafeOrStolen check (VIN, plate, or listing link) and save the result.
NICB, NMVTIS, and police are separate official resources; SafeOrStolen does not search them. Tool: https://safeorstolen.com/vin-checker
